title: Faraday's law: a magnet falling through a loop (3D+t)
description: A neodymium-like cylinder magnet falls along the axis of a wire loop. The 3-D field of the magnet is computed at every instant (vector potential and Biot-Savart of its bound surface current), the flux through the loop by Stokes' theorem, and the EMF = -dPhi/dt. Checked against Maxwell's coaxial-circle formula, the free-fall time at which the EMF changes sign, and the net flux change over the whole fall; the field in time is the animation.
